entities.summary: Oliver Korn is a field hockey player from Germany. He was a member of the Men's National Team that won the gold medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2012 Summer Olympics. Oliver Korn was a athletes & competitors from Düsseldorf (b. 1984-06-10, Düsseldorf). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
